verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly reference sharing Actors, managing organizations, and permissions (apify-docs-9), and Actors are described as designed to be shared/integrated/built upon (apify-docs-13), but the pack lacks detail on role granularity, invitation flows, or independent/hands-on confirmation of the org/permissions system. missing for 10: detailed RBAC documentation, screenshots/first-party walkthrough of org management, independent user corroboration of team collaboration features.
